sources.note: Brief uses mm for dimensions and kN for the rider force; use mm and kN consistently.
Envelope 180 mm along x, 40 mm along upward y, and 30 mm along z; domain origin at minimum corner.
Aluminium 7075 is stated. Assume homogeneous isotropic linear elasticity with E=71.7 kN/mm^2 (71.7 GPa) and Poisson ratio 0.33; elastic constants and material temper are unspecified.
Brief specifies 0.3; tool defines fraction over non-passive design volume, with the retained boss excluded.
Brief specifies 1 mm elements; h=1 mm.
Brief fixes everything in a diameter-20 mm circle centered at x=20,y=20 through the thickness. Radius=20/2=10 mm; z span 0 to 30 mm. Fix x,y,z translations to represent the stated keyed spindle.
Brief gives total 1.2 kN downward load on the diameter-16 mm circular outer boss face at z=30 mm; y is up, so force=(0,-1.2,0) kN. Tool distributes force equally among selected face nodes.
Brief requires solid diameter-16 mm boss centered at x=160,y=20, axis z, through full thickness. Radius=16/2=8 mm; z span 0 to 30 mm.
